title: Selective retrieval changes the full cost model
method: Synthetic decimal-volume model:50,000×20 MB=1,000 GB and 50,000×2 MB=100 GB. At assumed $0.08/GB costs are $80 and $8. Adding $40 of query capability leaves $32 net modeled reduction. Rates are illustrative, not provider prices.
alt: Selective retrieval changes the full cost model. Original transfer: 80 USD/month; Selective transfer: 8 USD/month; Added query capability: 40 USD/month. Illustrative values.
